Subject: What we're packing this winter — staff picks
Preview: A few things we actually reached for this season.
Body: Hey,

Winter has a way of sorting out what's worth carrying and what stays in the closet. This month, a few of us on the team put together a short list of the gear we've genuinely been reaching for — nothing flashy, just the stuff that kept showing up on our trips.

No discounts here. These are just picks we'd tell a friend about on the trailhead.

We'll keep adding to this list as the season goes on. If something catches your eye, the full notes from each staff member are linked below — they get into the specifics of how and where they used each piece, which is probably more useful than anything we'd write up here.

Stay warm out there.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
